t: LAP 2-gang LED dimmer switch that offers versatile lighting control with switchable leading or trailing edge modes for broad lamp compatibility. Screwless flat profile faceplate in antique brass with colour-matched inserts suit modern interiors whilst captive terminal screws accept cables up to 2.5mm². Dimmer features adjustable minimum dimming level, silent operation and no flicker performance. Soft-start function and current/thermal overload protection extend lamp lifespan and prevent circuit damage. Requires standard 35mm back box for installation. Suitable for mains voltage lighting with 2-way switching capability for multi-location control.
b: Leading Edge or Trailing Edge Option
